notes.notes:

v12 -  A whole new look

 Added 2 New Spells - 
 
  Aligu - Ties blocks together via a flexible string 
  Pordon - Points to the nearest door
 
 Added ~40 new decorations 
 Added ~64 new block textures
 Retextured collectibles

notes.title: Updates v 9.7 - Draw Angles, Bug Fixes, and Color Changes
notes.notes:
Features and QOL Updates:



 Adjusted the draw angles to make diagonal easier to register at the expense of making horizontal and vertical detection more explicit. 
Made Hot and Cold pedestals for dungeon entrances detect blocks further away.
Added a wizard color-changing button to the game.
Added in-game tips to the camp.
Added explicit messaging to indicate a new world is available when the player acquires a World Seed.
"Detruu" is now significantly cheaper.
"Level Select" text added to main menu.
Clarified some spell descriptions and Rune descriptions.
Clarified some text in camp instructional walls.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the puzzle button could come away from the button base and make the puzzle unsolvable.
 Fixed a bug where downward force was being applied after jumping.
 Added coded to clear up failed dungeon generations.

notes.title: v9.5 - Leaderboards Update
notes.notes:
Leaderboards in Game!

A leaderboard has been added to the game. Make sure Steam is running and clicking the "leaders" button on the main menu will display the global leaders indicating the highest level a player has visited.

Improvements
Added Volume Controls to the Escape Menu.
Added Right Stick Deadzone adjustment slide to the Escape Menu.
Added Tutorial Drawing Arrow Indicator toggle to the Escape Menu.
Added multiple fixes to the tutorial scene to better communicate the drawing mechanic.
Included an explicit input control selection at the beginning of the tutorial.
Added more music and sound effects to the game.
Improved stability of the tutorial.

notes.title: HotFix - Tutorial Signage and De-charging Information
notes.notes:
Pressing the Charge/Decharge button will now also remove any stored spells.
Spell Drawings have been posted next to Flying Block tutorial to illustrate the importance of direction better while inscribing spells.

notes.title: Tutorial and Camp Beautification Patch
notes.notes:
Added a dialog to Rune Doors telling players what runes they are missing and where to find them.
 Dungeons that fail to generate properly will now block off their entrances.
 The tutorial was overhauled for readability, consistency, and atmosphere.
 The camp was cleaned up for consistency, atmosphere, and messaging.
 Adjusted Store UI buttons and look.
 Fixed a UI glitch that tried to target non-existent scrollbar handle.

notes.title: Major Update TODAY! - Wizardry Squared v 7.0 - Void and Vehemence
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39573175/fce828f0b1dee53fbdc1165eafa4e01e4312b5f3.png
Explore the Void to find over 200 powerful runes, granting abilities and powerful new spells. Then head to the Arena and challenge a couch-mate to a Wizard's Duel!  

Massive New Rune System


 Equip new World and Void Runes to gain powers, modify spells, or enhance attributes. 
 Over 200 equipable Runes added to the game
 Collect the pieces of World Runes to unlock doors to complete Worlds.
 Find and open the ancient doors to the fragmented Void Worlds
 Find the hermit and learn of the nature of the Void
 Flush with that purple? Purchase Void Runes from the Hermit if you can find him!
 Overcome the challenges within Void Worlds to collect Void Runes


Wizard Dueling Arena

Challenge your couch-mate to a Wizard's Duel!

 Compete in a special Wizards Dueling Arena
 Arena options include: Random/Static, Floor Is Lava, No/Walls, Destructible 
 No death penalty! 
 Spells do not cost square in the arena! 


New Spells & Spell Types
14 New Spells have been added to the game.
Spells have been "classed"

Sequencing Spells
New Sequencing Spells of this type allow for delayed and repetitive actions of more complex spell combinations including permanent effects!

Legendary Spells
New Legendary spells, Fly, Stop Time and more are available through augmentation with World Runes


Updates
Many UI Updates - Spell Selection, Spell-Crafting, & Rune Selection.
New Boss Weapons and Defenses
Spell Selection/Crafting has been made easier
Rune Equipping UI has been added to the UI
New Dungeon Hazards and Puzzles
Ancient Doors to Void Worlds have been added to the game
Runic Gold Doors have been added to the game
Dungeon Museum added to the Camp
Wall of Runic Knowledge added to the Camp
Updated & Added Tutorial Videos to the Camp
Videos on Sequencing Spells, Dungeons, Gold Blocks, Puzzles and more
Many many Spell Bug fixes

notes.title: Dungeons & Loot Update
notes.notes:
Delve deep into the dungeons!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39573175/3b784b489e34c42770d647c8aba949b597f4c384.png

Added procedural dungeons to the game.
Each dungeon contains puzzles to unlock doors and significantly more gold than the level.
Enemies now drop hot/cold blocks used to unlock dungeon doors.
Enemies in dungeons can be much stronger.
Higher level dungeons may have difficult puzzles that require expensive spells.
Laid ground work for future equipment system.


Major Graphics Updates
2d Lights added for effect.
New Spell Effects
Post processing Effects
Remodeled the Camp
Attributes in Character Menu
Spells List in Character Menu
Main menu updates


New Spells and Upgraded Spells
Fixed spell descriptions to make them more understandable in the character menu.
Added Explosive, Push, pull, seek, telekenetic, and other spells to the game.
Added Quick Spells slots on the 1-4 and D-pad for instant preparation of spells.
Improved spell feedback on objects - they now display icons.



Enemies
Bosses can now utilize bombs/grenades
Bosses can now repel.
Bosses can spawn enemies.
Adjusted hit points.
Blocks now can take significantly more damage.


Bugs performance
Numerous performance improvements
Fixed stuck-directional movement bug.
Improved stick-aiming by making it more responsive.
Cursor now moved if not being used.
Tutorial adjusted to make it simpler.

Find and equip powerful gear!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39573175/e2f084e8b5b26b98f72849dd6e410ac14f6b6dfd.png


Added Loot System
Equippable items drop from Big Dungeon Chests

 Wands
 Belts
 Pouches
 Books


Items increase statistics based on their rarity and randomness.
Rarity increases as world seed increases.
The numbers of items from chests increase with world seed.

Major UI Updates
You can now assign spells to MetaSpells inside the Character Menu
You can now equip/unequip items in the Character Menu


Updated Main UI to show
World seed (orbs)
Better level information
Purple squares


Miscellaneous Fixes and QOL Features
Fixed some UI issues while running on lower resolutions.
Store UI Updates
Added Dungeon Introduction to the Tutorial
Spells assigned to Meta-spells now save between play sessions.
Arrow Spells now toggle on/off with repeated casts like all other spells.
Adjusted Hall of Instruction Scenery to not interfere with map.
Increase dungeon torch sensing radius for hot and cold blocks.
Alphabetized the spell list a bit.
Adjusted Inimicus behavior
World Indicator is Now a Ball-Counter under the Score UI.
Added verbage to world seed collection event to indicate the settings menu.
